title: Gmail scheduled email folder not showing, etc., on K-9
creator: S-Comp82
content:
I have several emails, set up in the Gmail app or on browser, that are "scheduled" to send at a particular date/time. This ability is very important for me.

But in K-9:

1) I can see the scheduled mails in All Mail, but there is no Scheduled folder, as there is in my Gmail app. 2) I can't find a way to set up a new Gmail "scheduled-send" using K-9. 3) I can't find a way to reschedule existing Gmail scheduled email within K-9.

Any ideas? Or are these abilities not possible with K-9?
